reason: B is more physically plausible because thermally activated grain-boundary segregation can occur during service-temperature aging while the bulk remains single phase, whereas A requires rapid principal-element nanoclustering during room-temperature, high-rate loading despite minimal time and thermal diffusion, and its citations do not support that mechanism. B remains underspecified and insufficiently distinguished from conventional segregation embrittlement, but it is the sounder proposal to refine and test.
